defect_registry.description: At 14:10:27 local the S53 adv53 harness EXECUTED the bare `obsidian` name (xtrace `++ obsidian` right after the M8 gui-sentinel check, /tmp/adv53/dbg-xtrace.log line ~1059); on this host that name resolves to /usr/bin/obsidian, the GUI launcher, so the real Obsidian desktop app spawned (pid 1994731, electron43 /usr/lib/obsidian/app.asar, parent = S53's bash -x adv53-harness.sh). The app ran ~70s, opened the shokoknowledge vault, rewrote .obsidian metadata, created /run/user/1000/.obsidian-cli.sock, then exited on a GPU fatal ('GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.').
defect_registry.vault_impact: CONTENT UNCHANGED — md manifest sha256 01e5efdb... and full content manifest 299d6b6a... are identical to pre-incident values; only .obsidian metadata changed (git status: M .obsidian/core-plugins.json, M .obsidian/workspace.json; diffs are plugin order and workspace UI state; no notes touched)
defect_registry.cli_side_effect: for ~70s the official CLI socket existed at /run/user/1000/.obsidian-cli.sock (first time observed on this host); it disappeared when the app exited
defect_registry.attribution: NOT caused by any judged candidate or by this seat's battery; no judged tool was in that process tree. The M8 hazard case was designed to prove the launcher is never executed; its own harness executed the name it guards against.
defect_registry.status: OPEN — routed to the parent: the round's safety claim 'the GUI launcher is never executed' holds for every judged run and this seat's battery, but NOT for the wave as a whole

cli_entry_point_finding.mechanism: second launch of the app binary connects to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/.obsidian-cli.sock as a client of the running app; no shim at ~/.local/bin/obsidian or /usr/local/bin/obsidian; socket absent; app not running

process_findings: Fixture interface chaos persists from r2: builders emit at least three key conventions (FIXTURE_ROOT/TARGET, ROOT/LEDGER/TARGET, FIXTURE_READY + LEDGER/TARGET); a judge must parse all three
Candidate vocabulary split: r2 (VERDICT\tpath\tSAFE...) vs r4 (VERIFIED / NOT-VERIFIED(reason) leading field-1); runners and judges must normalize or silently mis-score (runner-40 vs impl-24)

Version race: impl-20 was edited live through the judging window (eed52677 -> 52885564 -> 800a4fe8/86f5ffbc mid-edit -> 95fa4718); judging must pin shas at first and last contact — the judged sha is 95fa4718, verified stable across repeated hashing before the final battery run
Seat artifacts wrote fixture trees under tests/vault/ (s55-vault mode-000 files, 25+ MB mock-cli trees) — lane-cleanup candidate for a later round
verdict: WINNER-NAMED — souji-vault-verify.impl-20 (sha 95fa47182cc1) recommended for promotion; installed souji-verify remains the tool of record until the operator promotes; impl-21 and impl-24 carry open defects; no false-SAFE survives in the winner's P1-P10 battery and the real vault content + live ledger are byte-identical across every judged run; one lane-level GUI-spawn incident (V4-D7, seat S53 harness) is recorded and routed to the parent
